messages:
ops_jordan: Heads-up — scheduling a config-only deploy in the noon change window. Changes: routing weight tweaks, micro-batching params, shorter idle timeouts. Canary: 5% global but only in EU region for first 15m. Window: 12:00–12:30 PT today. No model versions changed. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/1765509876

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by ops_jordan. Job ID: db-20260323-17655. Planned start: 2026-03-23T12:00:00-07:00. Type: config-only. Canary fraction: 5% (region=EU).

maria: Thanks. Are we pinning any traffic to a fallback model for the canary?

alex: Not changing model, but pinning routing for the canary to the current stable variant (v2.3.1-infer-lite) so canary traffic has identical model. ops_jordan, added that to the rollout plan.

samir: Rollback criteria proposal: p50 latency increase > 120ms over baseline OR p95 > 300ms OR error rate (5xx+client 429) > 0.5% sustained for 2m OR KV cache evictions up > 20% in EU. If any of these hold, immediate rollback.

maria: Agreed. Add a soft-alert at +60ms p50 for attention. Also watch tail tokens/sec on the batching queue — if throughput drops 15% compare to baseline, consider rollback.

ops_jordan: Notes for on-call: canary runbook -> Grafana dashboard: infra/inference-routing-canary (panel: latency, error-rate, kvcache-evict, batch-queue-depth). Slack alert -> #eng-oncall + push to PagerDuty if hard criteria met.

alex: CLI rollback command in case deploy-bot cannot auto-unwind: 
```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --job db-20260323-17655 && redwoodctl config apply --from release/stable
```
Keep that handy.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Job db-20260323-17655 -> phase: CANARY (5% EU). Started at 2026-03-23T12:00:10-07:00.

maria: Observing first 5m. Watching p50 and kv eviction.

ops_jordan: Quick config snippet pushed (for reference):
```
{
  "routing": {"weights": {"stable": 0.95, "canary": 0.05}, "region": "eu"},
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 1024, "micro_batch_delay_ms": 6},
  "timeouts_ms": {"idle_request": 220, "kv_cache_ttl": 60000}
}
```
This is the config-only payload; no model artifacts.

samir: Noted. Micro_batch_delay 6ms is lower than default — should improve latency but watch queue headroom.

maria: 6m in: p50 +10ms, p95 unchanged, kvcache evict +2% — looks steady. :thumbsup:

ops_jordan: 12m in: increasing 429s in a few EU tenants — investigating whether routing weight concentration causing tenant spikes.

alex: If tenant-local spikes, we can immediately reduce canary fraction to 1% for EU while we triage: 
```
redwoodctl rollout scale --job db-20260323-17655 --fraction 0.01 --region eu
```

maria: Doing that now.

deploy-bot: Scaling canary to 1% (region=eu) as requested by maria.

samir: After scale-down, monitor if 429s drop. If not, cap per-tenant rate via runtime throttle for affected tenants and open quick postmortem.

ops_jordan: 20m mark: metrics normalized after scale-down. p50 back to baseline, 429s dropped. Recommend slow ramp to 5% global (geo-aware) after 10m stable.

alex: +1. Plan: hold at 1% for 10m, then 3%, then 5% if stable. ops_jordan to greenlight each step.

maria: I'll update release notes summary in case notes: "Config-only: routing fanout, micro-batching, reduced idle timeout. Canary EU then slow global ramp. Monitoring and rollback criteria documented."

ops_jordan: Final: canary completed full rollout to production at 12:45 PT with no rollback. Closing job db-20260323-17655. Release note link: https://redwood.internal/notes/1765509876/complete :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Job db-20260323-17655 -> COMPLETED. Duration: 00:45:50. No automatic rollback triggered.

maria: Nice work team. Leaving this thread in case any followups.
